paper_title: Particle dispersion in the classical vector dark matter background
suggested_experiment_name: VDM particle dispersion - dark photon model constraints (Fig. 6)
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing epsilon, dimensionless, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper constrains gauge couplings of Lmu-Ltau, Le-Lmu/tau, B-L and dark photon models via VDM background dispersion/normalization effects. Bounds are analytical mass-dependent formulas, not tabulated. The dark photon Z-bound (Eq.39) g_e<6.6e-39*(m/1e-20eV)^2 is expressed as gauge coupling g_e=eps*e, NOT directly as kinetic mixing chi; conversion to chi requires dividing by e. Also Eq.35 (electron mass): g_e<3.3e-12*(m/1e-20eV). Multiple models make coupling type ambiguous; dark photon is one of four.
